reviewNotes: HOLD - SQU's College of Medicine and Health Sciences states that its MD curriculum is outcome-based, case-based and integrated, and that the MD programme was re-accredited in 2023 for five years by AMEEMR in accordance with WFME standards. The college describes its relationship with Sultan Qaboos University Hospital for training and clinical service. SQU's Afaaq international-student document lists 220 credit hours at OMR 300 per hour and a total of OMR 64,560 for Medicine and Health Sciences. Hold pending confirmation that the Afaaq route is open to the intended nationality/current cycle, current entry and language criteria, cost inclusions/exclusions, accommodation/visa support and professional-registration analysis.
